about: Live-era glitch.com street encyclopedia pages (Wayback Machine). Each page's features line was the server's live count of the street's items (GSJS locations/location.js 3459-3460, 3572). The census takes the latest capture of every archived street page before the 2012-12-09 shutdown, and keeps the earlier sample's captures (October 2011, about 3 per hub). A street's count of each animal is its largest in any capture. Pages that answered Page not found are left out. Raw pages and the parser: glitch-audit research/wayback/raw/glitchcom-locations-live and research/wayback/tools/build-butterfly-census.py.
